Possess	 	 7	 years	 of	 experience	 in	 Full-stack	 Development,	 with	 expertise	 in	 back-end,	 frontend	and	cloud	technologies,	including	Node.js,	React,	Next.js,	Angular,	and	AWS	to	 deliver	scalable	solutions	for	diverse	clients.
Working	 as	 a	 Senior	 Software	 Engineer	 1	 at	 Marriott	 Tech	 Accelerator	 (Marriott	 International),	primarily	focused	on	building	the	orchestration	layer	for	the	Marriott	Bonvoy	 and	Marriott	Digital	ecosystem	using	Node.js,	Apollo	GraphQL	and	Amazon	Web	Services.	 • Developed	 strong	 expertise	 across	 full-stack	 engineering	 roles,	 with	 a	 focus	 on	 User	 Experience,	System	Design,	Agile	Project	Management,	Data	Visualization,	and	high- traffic	scalable	application	architecture,	consistently	delivering	performant,	reliable,	 and	high-quality	software	solutions	for	enterprise-scale	platforms.
Developed	and	deployed	scalable	solutions	at	Televox	Healthcare	using	Node.js,	improving
back-end	systems	for	virtual	agents	and	healthcare	platforms.	 Led	 the	 development	 of	 a	 highly	 successful	 campaign	 module,	 achieving	 an	 impressive	 conversion	rate	of	10%	at	Businessonbot.	 Proficient	in	using	front-end	technologies	like	React,	Next.js,		Angular,	and	TypeScript	to	 create	dynamic,	user-centric	interfaces	that	boost	engagement	and	satisfaction.	 Exhibited	leadership	by	fostering	a	collaborative	atmosphere,	promoting	innovation,	and	 mentoring	junior	engineers	to	enhance	their	technical	skills.

raw_sections.experience:
WORK	EXPERIENCE	 Marriott	Tech	Accelerator	|	Hyderabad		 Designation:	Senior	Software	Engineer	1
Mar’25	–	Present
Responsibilities:	 •
Core	 member	 of	 the	 node.js	 GraphQL	 orchestration	 team	 for	 the	 entire	 Marriott	 Bonvoy	 system,	architecting	federated	APIs	using	Apollo	GraphQL	to	unify	multiple	backend	domains	 and	client	channels	into	a	single	scalable	gateway
Designed	and	evolved	GraphQL	schema	architecture	and	resolver	strategy,	ensuring	clear

domain	boundaries,	reusability,	and	long-term	maintainability	across	services	 Integrated	AI-driven	Cursor	CLI	workflows	into	the	UXL	development	lifecycle,	leveraging	 custom	skills,	rules,	and	agents	to	automate	schema	generation,	resolver,	scaffolding,	and	code	 standardization	across	modules
Digital	Loyalty	:	Led	end-to-end	backend	architecture	for	Points	Transfer	to	Partner	Programs,	 designing	integration	flows,	handling	data	consistency,	and	ensuring	reliable	communication	 with	external	partner	systems	such	as	Starbucks
Digital	Loyalty	:	Architected	and	implemented	Givex	gift	card	integration,	including	secure transaction	flows,	failure	handling,retries,	and	external	service	orchestration
Digital	Content	:	Designed	a	dynamic	content	delivery	system	by	integrating	CMS-driven	APIs	 with	 GraphQL,	 enabling	 scalable,	 personalized,	 and	 real-time	 content	 rendering	 across	 channels	 Improved	system	performance	and	scalability	by	implementing	batching,	caching	strategies,	 and	request	deduplication,	significantly	reducing	latency	and	downstream	service	load	 Collaborated	with	multiple	domain	teams	to	define	API	contracts,	integration	standards,	and	 best	practices,	driving	consistency	and	alignment	across	the	platform


Mentored	engineers	and	contributed	to	architecture	discussions,	design	reviews,	and	technical decision-making,	influencing	backend	system	design	at	scale
raw_sections.awards:
Achievements:	 • Recognized	for	driving	backend	innovation	and	engineering	excellence	by	introducing	AI- assisted	 development	 workflows,	 optimizing	 system	 performance	 through	 caching	 and	 batching	strategies,	and	leading	critical	integrations	for	Digital	Loyalty	and	Content	platforms	 within	Marriott	International	systems
Velotio	|	Pune	 Designation:	Senior	Software	Engineer
Aug’22	–	Mar’25
Responsibilities:	 •	Full	stack	software	developer	for	clients	Netflix	and	Televox	Healthcare,	leveraging	Node.js,	React		 GraphQL,	and	TypeScript	to	build	scalable	APIs	and	service	integrations	 •	Netflix	:	Led	a	team	of	6	engineers	to	design	and	integrate	backend	services	supporting	the	 consolidation	of	corporate	and	animation	studio	platforms	 •	 Netflix	 :	 Developed	 and	 optimized	 backend	 APIs	 for	 the	 studio	 booking	 platform,	 ensuring	 efficient	data	handling,	scalability,	and	seamless	client	integration	 •	 Televox	 Healthcare	 :	 Architected	 and	 implemented	 secure	 authentication	 and	 authorization	 systems,	including	role-based	access	control	and	session	management	 •	Televox	Healthcare	:	Designed	and	developed	dynamic,	API-driven	form	systems	with	server-side	 validation	and	data	processing,	improving	flexibility	and	maintainability	 •	Televox	Healthcare	:	Led	a	team	of	engineers	to	build	backend	services	for	a	real-time	chat	 application,	focusing	on	scalability,	message	handling,	and	reliable	data	flow
Achievements:	 •
Demonstrated	strong	technical	leadership	by	managing	engineering	teams,	driving	platform	 consolidation	initiatives,	building	secure	authentication	systems,	and	developing	scalable	real- time	 communication	 and	 dynamic	 workflow	 solutions	 that	 improved	 system	 reliability,	 maintainability,	and	user	experience
Businessonbot	|	Bangalore	 Designation:	Front-end	Engineer
Jun’21	–	Aug’22
Responsibilities:	 •
Conceptualized	and	executed	an	intuitive	admin	dashboard	for	a	B2B	product,	leveraging	 Angular,	 SCSS,	 D3,	 and	 Tailwind	 CSS	 to	 enhance	 usability	 and	 provide	 insightful	 data	 visualizations.	 Implemented	a	module	for	running	campaigns	with	conversion	rate	around	10%.	 Engineered	 a	 versatile	 Shopify	 widget	 designed	 for	 rewards	 and	 referral	 programs,	 successfully	deployed	across	multiple	D2C	websites,	including	Happilo	and	PeeSafe,	to	amplify	 customer	engagement	and	retention.	 Implemented	a	user-friendly	feature	that	enabled	the	customization	of	WhatsApp	template	 messages	and	Shopify	widgets	directly	from	the	admin	dashboard,	streamlining	marketing	 efforts	and	enhancing	brand	communication.
•

Developed	a	robust	chat	module	that	empowered	agents	to	communicate	with	WhatsApp	 users	through	Socket.IO,	fostering	real-time	interactions	and	superior	customer	support.	 Collaborated	with	cross-functional	teams	to	gather	requirements	and	ensure	alignment	with	 business	objectives,	contributing	to	the	successful	delivery	of	high-quality	software	solutions.

Achievements:	 •
Played	a	pivotal	role	in	enhancing	user	engagement	through	the	development	of	innovative	 features	and	components,	while	fostering	collaboration	between	Technical	and	Design	Teams	 to	deliver	high-quality	software	solutions.
Semantic	Web	India	|	Bangalore	 Designation:	Front-end	Engineer
Feb’20	–	May’21
Responsibilities:	 •
Contributed	 to	 the	 development	 of	 "Bharathi,"	 a	 comprehensive	 collection	 of	 linked	 data	 vocabularies	tailored	for	the	Indian	context,	facilitating	seamless	metadata	integration	across	 various	governmental	functions.
Worked	closely	with	the	Angular	Front-end	Team	throughout	the	development	lifecycle,	from	 initial	 requirement	 gathering	 to	 successful	 production	 releases,	 ensuring	 high-quality	 deliverables.
Utilized	ngrx	for	comprehensive	state	management	across	the	application,	ensuring	robust


performance	and	scalability	while	enhancing	user	experience.	 Led	the	front-end	development	of	"Samraksha,"	a	versatile	cross-platform	application	built	on	 Ionic	5.0,	ensuring	optimal	functionality	and	user	engagement.	 Leveraged	front-end	technologies	to	develop	interactive	maps	using	Leaflet.js,	enhancing	user	 navigation	and	engagement	within	the	application.
Achievements:	 •
Collaborated	with	the	Centre	for	Cellular	and	Molecular	Biology	(CCMB),	Hyderabad,	in	the	 development	of	"Sandhi	Gene	Variant	Analysis"	(Sandhi	GVA),	a	cutting-edge	gene	variant	 analysis	tool	powered	by	Semantics.	 Contributed	to	the	development	of	innovative	applications	and	tools,	focusing	on	performance	 optimization	 and	 collaborative	 practices	 that	 enhanced	 team	 productivity	 and	 user	 satisfaction.

Reliance	Industries	Ltd.	|	Mumbai	 Designation:	Graduate	Engineering	Trainee
Aug’19	–	Feb’20
Responsibilities:	 •
Collaborated	within	the	Front-end	Team	to	contribute	to	the	development	of	EDC-360,	a	 project	aimed	at	automating	Reliance's	data	center	functionalities,	including	cloud	services	 and	data	center	tools.
Designed	and	implemented	user-friendly	dashboards	and	layouts,	ensuring	optimal	usability
and	functionality	while	adhering	to	best	practices	in	user	interface	design.
